# gives it, https://www.lectionarypage.net/ (read October 2026: the RCL

# Easter and the Vigil of Pentecost).  These rows are where it differs:
#   - the psalms are numbered as the Psalter of the Book of Common Prayer
#     (1979) numbers them (=psalm rows put the Prayer Book's reading in the
#     RCL's place), and where it appoints a canticle the canticle's text is
#     given: Canticle 3 or 15 = Luke 1:46-55, Canticle 4 or 16 = Luke 1:68-79
#     Canticle 9 = Isaiah 12:2-6, Canticle 2 or 13 = Song of the Three Young
#   - the First and Second Sundays after Christmas, Ash Wednesday's psalm
#     Holy Cross Day and the Major Feasts are the Prayer Book's;
#   - the days of Easter Week and the Vigil of Pentecost have propers.
# The Easter Vigil is the RCL's.  The Vigil of Pentecost's Gospel (cut off
# on the page) is the Prayer Book's, John 7:37-39a.

day: # The Daily Office Lectionary of the Book of Common Prayer (1979), pp. 934-1001,
# read from the Prayer Book's PDF edition in October 2026.
# Two years: Year One (cycle 1) begins on the First Sunday of Advent before an
# odd-numbered year, Year Two (cycle 2) before an even one (reading_cycle).
#   - "Morning and Evening Prayer": the psalms for each office, then three
#     lessons; the Prayer Book reads two at one office and the third at the
#     other (at Evening Prayer the Old Testament lesson, or the Gospel).
#     Psalms in parentheses may be omitted; "or" gives the book's choices.
#   - Weeks after Pentecost are the book's Propers, each the week of the
#     Sunday closest to a date (Proper 1, 11 May); the weekdays after the Day
#     of Pentecost and Trinity Sunday take the Proper whose Sunday is closest.
#   - The Eves of the feasts and Christmas Eve have their own Evening Prayer;
#     in Holy Week and on Easter Day Morning and Evening Prayer are given
#   - Starred Acts lessons in Easter Week duplicate the Eucharist's first
#     lesson; the book allows Year Two's in their place.  In Year Two, Judith
#     may be read in place of Esther (footnote, p. 985): given after "or".
#   - The Holy Days (pp. 996-999) at Morning and Evening Prayer, with the
#     Evening Prayer of their Eves; Special Occasions are not entered.
# Typos in the table are corrected and listed in docs/source-errors.csv.
